text:
deploy-bot: Deploy request queued: hotfix/rate-limiter v1.2.1 -> production eu-west1. Reason: sustained 10% 429 spike on Dedicated pools since 03:12 UTC. Change window: late window. Request expedited approvals: canary skip, traffic-shift to standby pool, version pin. @maria @lee @samantha please ack.

maria: Oncall / SRE / Product, need consensus. If we fast-track we pin to v1.2.1 and do staged traffic shift (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with 10m soak per step. Runbook attached.

lee: Oncall (lee) here, I'm watching. I need 2 engineers on pager and explicit rollback criteria.

ashley: Security review: patch only touches rate-limiter config, no secrets, no config-store perms changed. :white_check_mark:

_tim: product_ tim: Need release note stub and customer-safe blurb. I'll draft in the next 10m, don't publish until we confirm stable.

devops: I'll stage the standby pool and pre-warm instances. Also need to skip canary flag set in deploy metadata: `skip_canary=true`. Two engineers ready: @devops and @samantha.

samantha: SRE: root cause confirmed (burst miscalc under auth-proxy). Patch ready and tested in staging. +1 for expedited; agree with staged shift and strict metric gates: 429s down, p50 latency within +10%.

maria: Approvals: maria +1 (release manager). ashley +1 (security). tim +1 (product) pending release note. lee +1 (oncall) conditional on runbook and rollback criteria. samantha +1 (sre).

deploy-bot: Approval check: approvals received (maria, ashley, samantha, lee). Deployment ETA: 5m. Action: start traffic-shift orchestration.

devops: Command being run:```
kubectl -n infra apply -f ./deploys/hotfix-rate-limiter-v1.2.1.yaml
kubectl -n infra patch svc traffic-router -p '{"spec": {"weights": {"primary": 80, "standby": 20}}}'
```

deploy-bot: Deploy started: hotfix/rate-limiter v1.2.1 -> eu-west1. Step 1: shift 10% traffic to standby.

maria: Notifying stakeholders: #customer-bulletins queued, internal status page draft ready. tim will approve copy.

lee: Observability hooks live. I'm watching error budget and 429 rate. If 429 > baseline+2% for 5m we rollback.

deploy-bot: Step 1 complete: 10% shift, soak 10m initiated. Monitoring: 429s trending down 60% vs spike; p50 latency +2ms.

devops: Increasing to 50% now. Command: `traffic-router weight standby=50`

deploy-bot: Step 2 complete: 50% shift, soak 10m. Metrics: 429s down to baseline, no new latency regressions.

samantha: Confirming metrics in Grafana dashboard: https://grafana.company/eu-rate-limiter (metrics green). Proceed to 100%.

devops: Final shift to 100% executed. `traffic-router weight standby=100`

deploy-bot: Deployment complete: traffic at 100% to patched pool. No rollback triggered. Auto-pin applied: service pinned to hotfix/rate-limiter@v1.2.1.

ashley: Quick check on logs: no auth failures, no suspicious spikes. :thumbsup:

tim: Publishing customer-facing note now. Internal note: https://confluence.company/ops/hotfix-rate-limiter-v1.2.1

maria: Closing fast-track: release manager sign-off. Postmortem to be scheduled if any regression. Thanks everyone for quick responses. :partyparrot:

lee: Oncall will remain watching for 2h. If anything tilts we rollback to v1.2.0 and re-open thread.

deploy-bot: Automation: reminder scheduled to remove pin in 7 days unless overridden.
